Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Asset type: precise visual proposal for a four-direction road layout in the existing Russian farming RPG "Лунная долина".
Input image: the real supplied gameplay screenshot is the edit target and the strict art/layout reference. Change ONLY the beige dirt footpaths so all their straight center-line segments run horizontally or vertically, joined by 90-degree turns. Remove the visible diagonal dirt path segments.
Preserve the cottage, its doorway and steps, both human sprites and their names, trees, stump, flowers, fenced field, noticeboard, lamps, water, original bridge, HUD, celestial clock and hotbar in their exact existing positions and art style. Preserve the naturally diagonal RIVER; the request is to straighten paths, not water. Do not add buildings, characters or scenery, do not repaint assets in a new style.
Road layout: a vertical approach from the cottage door joins a horizontal lane through the grandmother/player area. The branch to the lower-left fenced field is L-shaped: travel west horizontally from the cottage junction, then south vertically through the existing gap in the fence; no sloping connector. The route to the upper-right wooden bridge goes east horizontally, then north vertically to the existing bridge entrance. The lower/right branches also form horizontal/vertical L or T junctions around the existing apple tree and fences. Keep paths out of river/water, out of tree trunks and other solid props, and keep their endpoints connected to the same doors, bridge and field opening as the source.
Style: use the same granular beige dirt texture, green grass and sprite scale as the reference. The road strips have consistent width and understated grass edging, with nearly square elbow joins and slightly worn natural edges; no long diagonal runs, no zigzag staircase imitation of a diagonal, no isometric diamond tiles, no modern stone paving. World roads should feel deliberately laid out but retain the rustic farming-game look.
Composition: the exact same camera and landscape gameplay screenshot, flat orthographic 2D RPG, no perspective redesign, no diagram arrows or labels, no before/after split, no title card. This is a review mockup; it will be implemented from reusable road materials and horizontal/vertical/corner/T/cross pieces, not installed as a single background image. Keep Cyrillic UI text and item art unchanged as closely as possible.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: four cardinal-direction wardrobe sprite DESIGN SHEET for the existing farming RPG "Лунная долина". This is a separate review concept sheet, not an installed game atlas.
Input image: the existing wooden wardrobe is the strict reference for warm brown wood, gold handles, rustic moulding, small crest ornament, simple pixel/painted sprite detail and proportions. The old sprite has an unwanted diagonal three-quarter/isometric orientation. Redraw its design with four strictly axis-aligned orthographic views for an overhead 2D RPG.
One clean wide landscape sheet on a pale neutral parchment background, four equal panels arranged left to right. Small accurate Russian captions above panels: "ВНИЗ", "ВВЕРХ", "ВЛЕВО", "ВПРАВО". Each isolated wardrobe has equal pixel density, consistent body height, same bottom ground line, subtle small contact shadow and sufficient clean space around it. No decorative panel frames or extra objects.
SOUTH / ВНИЗ: straight frontal view of the two doors, both symmetrical gold handles visible, front vertical edges truly vertical, top and bottom edges horizontal, crown ornament centred, a thin flat top surface visible. No visible diagonal side face, no rhombus base, no 45-degree or three-quarter view.
NORTH / ВВЕРХ: back of the SAME wardrobe with plain vertical boards, horizontal cross braces and the same crown/body height. No door handles on the back. Entire silhouette straight and squared up to the camera, same level overhead look.
WEST / ВЛЕВО: exact orthographic narrow left-side view of the same wardrobe, one flat wood panel with horizontal trim and a narrow top strip; the front faces left outside the camera, not toward the camera. Straight horizontal/vertical edges, do NOT show the frontal doors in three-quarter perspective.
EAST / ВПРАВО: exact orthographic narrow right-side view, consistent with the west view and same depth/height. No 45-degree rotation and no diagonal edges. No duplicated frontal south-view pretending to be a side view.
Style: match the reference's handcrafted farming-game sprite style and warm materials, restrained ornament and clean shapes readable at about 80–120 game pixels tall. Preserve enough wood detail and tiny shading for depth, but make every major structural edge align with the screen axes. Horizontal base footprint instead of the old diagonal slab. No photorealism, no rendered 3D isometric cabinet, no dramatic lighting, no new theme, no extra furniture. The purpose is to demonstrate true north/south/east/west furniture poses that can later be sliced into individual game sprites.
